text:
lee.security: quick note 14a1 Our staging DAST callbacks started failing after yesterday's RBAC tighten on scanner SAs; also saw a SAST hit in generated scan client (hardcoded placeholder). opening thread to track.
sam.platform: removed broad token:exchange binding from scanner-sa to shrink blast radius; might've blocked ephemeral token mint.
ben.oncall: paused callback consumer to stop retries. logs show: `403 token exchange denied` and missing X-Signature header on incoming callbacks.
kyra.devx: generator currently writes a dev placeholder to /tmp when SCAN_KEY env is missing. SAST flagged hardcoded secret. snippet: `if (!process.env.SCAN_KEY) fs.writeFileSync('/tmp/scan_key','dev-scan')`.
lee.security: immediate plan: (1) temporary RBAC rollback for scanner-sa (short window), (2) patch generator to use KMS.decrypt() into memory, (3) add narrow SAST ignore for `generated/scan_*` with audit link.
ci-bot: deploy started: hotfix/rebind-scanner-sa -> staging (ci-771).
audit-bot: RBAC_CHANGE user=ben.oncall ts=5567801220 action=add_binding reason="restore scanner callbacks" revert_window=15m
kyra.devx: opening PR to stop disk writes and add unit tests. will include comment header for SAST and link to GH issue tracking suppression justification.
sam.platform: also filing GH issue to add preflight callback simulator in RBAC change workflow so future removals get tested.
lee.security: documenting incident as "scan-integration-authz" in tracker INC-5567 with links to PR and audit entry. follow-ups: rotation check on KMS keys and add SDLC check to ban disk plaintext writes.
ben.oncall: reverted at 5567801245 after patch merged. closing loop and adding note to RBAC playbook. :white_check_mark:
